evals.prompt: Complete the next backlog item after recording passing tests.
evals.expected_output: Select the current active record, retain its GUID, record concrete evidence, then complete that GUID and verify the next item.
assertions: The selected item GUID is used for completion.
Evidence is recorded before the done command.
The final list has contiguous active priorities starting at zero.

evals.prompt: Inspect done work from feature while currently on main.
evals.expected_output: Use list done --branch feature --json; show GUIDs and completion dates without modifying either branch.
assertions: The branch argument selects feature for the list.

evals.prompt: Reset generated backlog skills while retaining backlog data.
evals.expected_output: Plan init backup, verify its data-preserving effect, run it, confirm records survive, and remind the user to commit.
assertions: The command is init backup rather than init clean.
The manifest records retain their GUIDs.
